race.comment: KVAS (9) was no match for the easy winner but beat the rest over the Ipswich dash fresh. Fitter and is overdue for a win. Looks very well placed this weak line-up. JIGADEE (2) did his best work late and finished third last time over 870m at this track, beaten 0.6 lengths. In the right race and is a key runner. THAT'S A BEAUTY (12) finished 4.5 lengths from the winner in fifth after being prominent at the turn at her most recent outing over 1100m at this track. Among the better chances in what looks a nice race. I WASONLY NINETEEN (1) is a first starter by Jet Spur out of Goodnight Saigon. Runner-up in only trial here. Tricky gate but showed ability in trial and worth watching. AKKU (5) is sure to be thereabouts on best form.
